name: gmail-filter-toolbar
description: Filter Gmail by calendar invites, attachments, starred messages, or regular mail.
author: Kevinjohn Gallagher

scripts.build: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox vite build && cross-env BROWSER=firefox vite build --config vite.background.config.mjs
scripts.build:safari: cross-env BROWSER=safari vite build && cross-env BROWSER=safari vite build --config vite.background.config.mjs
scripts.safari:convert: pnpm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari-xcode --app-name 'Gmail Filter Toolbar' --bundle-identifier com.kevinjohngallagher.Gmail-Filter-Toolbar --macos-only --no-open --no-prompt --force
scripts.safari:open: open safari-xcode/Gmail\ Filter\ Toolbar/Gmail\ Filter\ Toolbar.xcodeproj
scripts.firefox:run: pnpm run build:firefox && cross-env web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox-preview
scripts.firefox:package: pnpm run build:firefox && cross-env web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
